title: feat/Adding support for --output flag for remote users
body:
Fixes: #28342

### Description

This PR introduces support for the `--output` flag when running remote builds (`podman-remote build`), enabling remote clients to stream build artifacts and root filesystems back to their local machine.

#### What changed?
 For this when the image is created on the server side, we create a container around it and then stream it through `export()` API of the container and later, when the work is done we delete the container from the server side through `defer`. 
 
 I was also thinking to delete the image created on the server side to delete, but I haven't done that here to match the same thing when running podman locally.
